CookFlow
https://eurocookflow.com/

CookFlow is a culinary learning platform focused on chef-led masterclasses, technique-first recipes, culinary science notes, and planning workflows for ambitious home cooks and professionals.

Public pages:
- Home: https://eurocookflow.com/
- Privacy: https://eurocookflow.com/legal/privacy
- Terms: https://eurocookflow.com/legal/terms
- VAT info: https://eurocookflow.com/legal/vat

Preferred summary:
- CookFlow helps cooks progress through structured culinary lessons, curated recipes, and workflow tools instead of relying on disconnected recipe collections.
- The platform combines lessons, recipes, chef profiles, meal planning, and shopping support under a credit-based access model.
